description:
A Korean couple living in Tokyo (Aoling and her husband) suddenly decide to open a Korean restaurant one day. Seeing the success of other Korean restaurants in Tokyo, they set out with high hopes... but business is far from easy. From the location to the interior, the taste, and even the customer service, nothing is easy. They regret underestimating the value of business and struggle to keep it afloat. Days pass, and customers arrive one by one...

What kind of customers will they meet? Will their business survive? Stay tuned for this captivating story of a small business!

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)
